about_short_description.short_description: Babylon Labs offers a protocol for native Bitcoin staking, letting users earn rewards while keeping self-custody of their BTC.

product.name: Babylon Bitcoin Staking Protocol
product.description: A native Bitcoin staking protocol that lets BTC holders lock Bitcoin from their own wallets to help secure proof-of-stake chains and other decentralized systems while receiving staking rewards.

product.name: Trustless Bitcoin Vaults
product.description: A native Bitcoin collateral infrastructure that allows users to lock BTC in vaults, make its collateral status verifiable on Ethereum, borrow stablecoins, and recover the BTC after repayment.

product.name: Bitcoin Supercharged Network Security
product.description: A service and integration framework that enables proof-of-stake chains, rollups, and other decentralized networks to use Bitcoin staking for additional security and access to Bitcoin liquidity.

product.name: Finality Provider Services
product.description: Validator infrastructure and participation services for operators that help secure Bitcoin Supercharged Networks by providing Bitcoin-backed finality through the Babylon protocol.

product.name: Institutional Bitcoin Staking
product.description: Native Bitcoin staking access and infrastructure for institutions through Babylon’s protocol and integrations with custodians, wallets, staking providers, and institutional digital-asset platforms.
